scripts.check:test: bunx tsc -p tsconfig.test.browser.json --pretty false && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.test.server.json --pretty false
scripts.typecheck: bun run check:browser && bun run check:worker && bun run check:bun && bun run check:tooling && bun run check:test
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build:client && bunx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build:client && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply airing-list-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply airing-list-db --remote
